Lemma
[Elementary bound for changing distances] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0291, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0292 1. ch24:24.7\group Local Parametrix

If $\lvert \mathcal R_{ij}\rvert \le C$, then, away from the cut locus, \[ \left|\partial _\tau r_\tau (x)\right|\le C r_\tau (x). \]
Proof

\sketch The first variation formula gives $ \partial _\tau L_{g(\tau )}(\gamma ) =\int _\gamma \mathcal R_\tau (\dot\gamma ,\dot\gamma ),ds $ for each minimizing geodesic. Taking the infimum and using the tensor bound proves the estimate.

□
